name: Hans-Rudolf Zimmermann
bio:
Hans-Rudolf's path to motorsport was unconventional. After earning a degree in mechanical engineering from ETH Zurich, he spent several years designing precision instruments. The meticulous nature of that work, coupled with a lifelong fascination with Formula 1, eventually led him to pursue a career in racing. He joined a smaller team as a junior engineer, quickly rising through the ranks due to his sharp analytical skills and relentless pursuit of efficiency.

At Crown Racing, Hans-Rudolf oversees all technical aspects of the team's operations. He believes in a data-driven approach, constantly analyzing performance metrics to identify areas for improvement. While not always the most charismatic, his unwavering focus on results and his ability to extract maximum performance from the available resources have earned him the respect of his colleagues. He is known for his methodical approach and his ability to quickly diagnose and resolve complex technical issues, making him an invaluable asset to the team.

What sets Hans-Rudolf apart is his ability to balance the theoretical with the practical. He is not afraid to get his hands dirty and can often be found on the shop floor, working alongside the mechanics. His deep understanding of both the engineering principles and the practical limitations of the car allows him to make informed decisions that optimize performance in real-world conditions.

physical.description: A lean man with a stern but intelligent gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, even to lunch.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on double-checking every calculation, regardless of who performed it.
